title: fanoutqa: What were the ages of the five most recent presidents of the United States? (95de313fdfef9d01)

chat_history.content: What were the ages of the five most recent presidents of the United States?

content.content:
The user asks: "What were the ages of the five most recent presidents of the United States?" We need to provide ages. Likely as of now (2025) or at some point? Could be current ages (living) or ages at death? Usually "ages" could mean current age if alive, or age at death if deceased. The five most recent presidents as of 2025: Joe Biden (46th), Donald Trump (45th), Barack Obama (44th), George W. Bush (43rd), Bill Clinton (42nd). Actually five most recent includes the current president Joe Biden, then Donald Trump, Barack Obama, George W. Bush, Bill Clinton. Need ages: We need to compute current ages as of today (2025-10-31). Let's compute.

We need birthdates:
- Joe Biden: born November 20, 1942.
- Donald Trump: born June 14, 1946.
- Barack Obama: born August 4, 1961.
- George W. Bush: born July 6, 1946.
- Bill Clinton: born August 19, 1946.

Now compute ages as of 2025-10-31.

Biden: from 1942-11-20 to 2025-10-31. He hasn't had birthday yet in 2025 (Nov 20). So age = 2025 - 1942 - 1 = 82. (He will turn 83 on Nov 20, 2025). So age 82.

Trump: born June 14, 1946. By Oct 31 2025, his birthday passed (June). Age = 2025 - 1946 = 79.

Obama: born Aug 4, 1961. By Oct 31 2025, birthday passed. Age = 2025 - 1961 = 64.

George W. Bush: born July 6, 1946. Birthday passed. Age = 2025 - 1946 = 79.

Bill Clinton: born Aug 19, 1946. Birthday passed. Age = 2025 - 1946 = 79.

Thus ages: Biden 82, Trump 79, Obama 64, Bush 79, Clinton 79.

Check: Trump and Bush and Clinton same birth year 1946, but Trump's birthday June, Bush July, Clinton August, all have turned 79.

Thus answer. Provide maybe a table. Also note they are living. Provide note about calculation date.

No need to call external tool. Just answer.

content:
**Ages of the five most recent U.S. presidents (as of 31 October 2025)**  

| President (order) | Date of birth | Age on 31 Oct 2025 |
|-------------------|---------------|-------------------|
| Joe Biden (46th)  | 20 Nov 1942   | **82** years (turns 83 on 20 Nov 2025) |
| Donald Trump (45th) | 14 Jun 1946   | **79** years |
| Barack Obama (44th) | 4 Aug 1961    | **64** years |
| George W. Bush (43rd) | 6 Jul 1946   | **79** years |
| Bill Clinton (42nd) | 19 Aug 1946  | **79** years |

All five presidents are still living, so the ages shown are their current ages on the specified date.
